segments.name: U.S.
segments.description: Sells parasiticides, vaccines, dermatology, anti-infectives, pain and sedation and diagnostics to companion animal and livestock customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: Our operating segments are the U.S. and International.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells the same animal health portfolio to companion animal and livestock customers in markets outside the United States.
segments.evidence: Within each of these operating segments, we offer a diversified product portfolio, including parasiticides, vaccines, dermatology, anti-infectives, pain and sedation, other pharmaceutical and animal health diagnostics, for both companion animal and livestock customers.

revenueModel.text: Veterinarians, livestock producers, pet owners and third parties pay for animal health medicines, vaccines, diagnostics and contract manufacturing services.
revenueModel.evidence: We directly market our products to veterinarians and livestock producers located in approximately 45 countries across North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia and South America

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed the divestiture of its medicated feed additive product portfolio, certain water soluble products and related assets.
changes.evidence: On October 31, 2024, we completed the divestiture of our medicated feed additive product portfolio, certain water soluble products and related assets

changes.text: In 2023 the company sold a majority interest in its pet insurance business.
changes.evidence: a gain on the sale of a majority interest in our pet insurance business
